summary: Adds a narrow checkpoint resume executor for the CleanupCommittedStaging action. The executor consumes the action plan, revalidates materialized destination content plus staged/receipt sidecars, removes only DB-bound cleanup artifacts, and updates SQLite cleanup evidence back to an AlreadyConverged restart state.
audit_findings: Rev0683 correctly made MaterializeStagedFile executable, but intentionally left staged receipts and cleanup rows pending as CleanupCommittedStaging.
The cleanup branch must be evidence-bound too: deleting receipt sidecars is only safe after destination content, checkpoint chunk rows, receipt keys, and staging paths all still agree.
Existing terminal repair logic handles reappeared artifacts after SQLite already says cleanup is committed; rev0684 fills the separate pending-cleanup state where SQLite still needs to be advanced.
cleanup_resume_checks: execute_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_cleanups loads plan_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_actions and mutates only files classified as CleanupCommittedStaging.
The executor refuses QuarantineStaging and RejectDrift plans by default.
The checkpoint database is opened read/write only after root, identity, and sqlite path safety checks are repeated.
The destination target is rehashed against checkpointed size/content hash evidence before any staged artifact is removed.
A leftover staged file is removed only when it is a regular file and still matches checkpointed source content.
Every receipt sidecar is rehashed back to the persisted sync-chunk-receipt:v1 idempotency key before deletion.
Unexpected receipt-directory children, wrong-kind receipts, missing durable receipt rows, and receipt content mismatches fail closed.
The executor writes or refreshes sync_session_cleanup_checkpoints with a sync-transfer-cleanup:v1 idempotency key and updates sync_session_file_results cleanup state.

Accepted receipt rows are transitioned to committed-cleaned, aggregate cleanup counters are recomputed from cleanup checkpoints, and post-action verification expects AlreadyConverged plus a strict terminal resume view.
